# What api-diff's focus job (and api-probe with [api-focus]) prints straight into its log; the workflows list the kinds
# of line. "datadiff <path>" lines are printed by api-diff's overrides job, 26.3's file against 26.4's.
calls net.minecraft.client.renderer.rendertype.RenderTypes lines.*|secondaryBlockOutline|lambda.*
calls net.minecraft.client.renderer.LevelRenderer submitHitOutline
calls net.minecraft.client.renderer.feature.GizmoFeatureRenderer buildLines
member net.minecraft.client.renderer.rendertype.RenderTypes [Ll]ine|[Oo]utline|OIT|Oit
member net.minecraft.client.renderer.rendertype.RenderSetup [Oo]it|OIT|translucent|builder
calls net.minecraft.client.renderer.rendertype.RenderSetup .*[Oo]it.*|.*[Tt]ranslucent.*|build
uses getPreMoveCollisions
calls net.minecraft.world.level.CollisionGetter getPreMoveCollisions|getBlockCollisions|getCollisions|noCollision
